sources.title: Image-text Retrieval with Main Semantics Consistency
sources.snippet: Image-text retrieval (ITR) has been one of the primary tasks in cross-modal retrieval, serving as a crucial bridge between computer vision and natural language processing. Significant progress has been made to achieve global alignment and local alignment between images and texts by mapping images and texts into a common space to establish correspondences between these two modalities.
